The operation is a no-op if:
cursorRow < scrollTop (cursor is above the scroll region)
cursorRow > scrollBottom (cursor is below the scroll region)

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Pn @ — Insert Characters (ICH).

detaileddescription.para: Inserts count blank cells at the cursor position, shifting existing cells to the right. Cells that fall beyond the right margin are discarded.

count
Number of blank cells to insert (>= 1).
READER THREAD only.
Inserts blank cells directly in Grid at the cursor column, shifting existing cells to the right. Cells that shift past the right margin are discarded. The cursor position is not changed.

parameterdescription.para: Number of blank cells to insert (>= 1).

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Pn P — Delete Characters (DCH).

detaileddescription.para: Deletes count cells starting at the cursor position, pulling subsequent cells to the left. Blank cells are inserted at the right margin.

count
Number of cells to delete (>= 1).
READER THREAD only.
Removes cells directly in Grid, shifting remaining cells to the left and inserting blank cells at the right margin. The cursor position is not changed.

parameterdescription.para: Number of cells to delete (>= 1).

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Pn X — Erase Characters (ECH).

detaileddescription.para: Replaces count cells starting at the cursor position with blank cells using the current background colour. The cursor does not move.

count
Number of cells to erase (>= 1).
READER THREAD only.
Blanks cells directly in Grid without shifting surrounding content. The cursor position is not changed. ECH is a cell-layer operation — the image layer is not affected.

parameterdescription.para: Number of cells to erase (>= 1).

briefdescription.para: Handles CSI Ps b — Repeat preceding graphic character (REP).

detaileddescription.para: Repeats the last graphic character printed Ps times at the current cursor position, advancing the cursor. Uses the existing print() path so that all Grid writes, dirty marking, and wrap handling are consistent.

parameterdescription.para: Number of repetitions (default 1).

briefdescription.para: Switches between the normal and alternate screen buffers.

detaileddescription.para: When switching to the alternate screen, the normal screen state is saved and the alternate screen is cleared. When switching back, the normal screen state is restored. Corresponds to the ?1049h / ?1049l private mode sequences.

shouldUseAlternate
true to activate the alternate screen, false to return to the normal screen.
READER THREAD only.
Updates activeScreen to the target. No-op guard is applied: if the target screen is already active, the function returns immediately without any state mutation.

briefdescription.para: Appends a null-terminated response string to responseBuf.

detaileddescription.para: Appends a null-terminated response string to the internal response buffer.
Accumulates device responses during action processing so they can be delivered in a single write after processing completes. If the response would overflow responseBuf, it is silently truncated.

responseBuf
Responses (device attribute replies, cursor position reports, etc.) are not sent immediately during process(). Instead they are accumulated here and flushed after process() returns via flushResponses(). This avoids re-entrant writes to the PTY during parsing.
If the response would overflow responseBuf, it is silently discarded.

briefdescription.para: Events map owned by Processor.

detaileddescription.para: Video fires events through this map.

Registered event keys fired by Video:
"writeToHost" — (const char*, int) — device response bytes, reader thread
"bell" — () — BEL character, dispatched via callAsync
"clipboardChanged" — (const juce::String&) — OSC 52, dispatched via callAsync
"desktopNotification" — (const juce::String&, const juce::String&) — OSC 9/777, dispatched via callAsync
"imageDecoded" — image pixel data + placement metadata, reader thread
"previewFile" — (const juce::String&, int, int, int, int) — reader thread
"dcsPayloadComplete" — (const uint8_t*, int) — DCS ST received, reader thread
"apcPayloadComplete" — (const uint8_t*, int) — APC ST/BEL received, reader thread
"activeScreen" / "cursor" — flush(), reader thread. "cursor" is packed CursorState (row+col+visible+kbFlags).
"applicationCursor" / "bracketedPaste" / mode flags — (bool) — flush(), reader thread

briefdescription.para: Resets Video and the terminal to a clean initial state.

detaileddescription.para: Performs a full terminal reset (RIS — Reset to Initial State).
Clears the pen, cursor, scroll region, tab stops, and all mode flags. Equivalent to a hard terminal reset (RIS, ESC c).

READER THREAD only.
Equivalent to the ESC c sequence. Restores the terminal to a clean power-on state:
Resets activeScreen to normal.
Homes the cursor via resetCursor().
Resets all mode flags via resetModes().
Resets the active pen via resetPen().
Disables the line-drawing charset.
Fires id::clearBuffer event to clear the normal screen.
Calls calc() to synchronise internal cached geometry.

briefdescription.para: Marks the pen style cache dirty and recomputes cached geometry.

detaileddescription.para: Marks penStyleDirty so that currentStyleId() will re-query the Stamp table on the next cell write. Called internally by setWinsize() and reset().

READER THREAD only.
setWinsize()
Sets penStyleDirty so that currentStyleId() will re-query the Stamp table on the next cell write. Must be called after construction and after every setWinsize(). Also called internally by cursorSetScrollRegion() and cursorResetScrollRegion().

briefdescription.para: Delivers any queued device responses to the host via the writeToHost event.

detaileddescription.para: Delivers all queued response bytes to the host via the "writeToHost" event.

During action processing, responses (DA, CPR, …) are accumulated in responseBuf rather than sent immediately. Call this method after Parser's process() returns to flush the buffer through the "writeToHost" handler registered in the events map.

READER THREAD only.
sendResponse()
Processor::events
Called by the owner (Session) after each process() invocation. If responseLen > 0 and the "writeToHost" handler is registered in the events map, the entire responseBuf is passed to the handler and responseLen is reset to zero.

briefdescription.para: Returns the styleId for the current pen state, updating the cache if dirty.

detaileddescription.para: Looks up or inserts the current {penFg, penBg, penFlags} triple in the Stamp table and caches the result in penStyleId until one of the pen components changes. Called by print() and currentStyleId().

briefdescription.para: Returns a styleId with the current background but default fg and zero flags.

detaileddescription.para: Per VT spec, erase operations clear cells using the current SGR background but ignore all text attributes (fg colour, bold, italic, etc.). Alpha == 0 for fg signals the renderer to substitute the theme default.

briefdescription.para: Returns the effective bottom row of the current scrolling region.

detaileddescription.para: Uses the single active scrollBottom register and current visible rows.

effectiveScrollBottom()
Reads from Grid buffer dims (safe on reader thread) on every call. Wraps effectiveScrollBottom() with the current screen and visible rows.

briefdescription.para: VT command processor: receives decoded actions, writes Buffer, holds calculation inputs.

detaileddescription.para: Video is the VT command processor. It receives decoded semantic actions from Parser and translates them into mutations of the cell buffer. It holds calculation inputs: the drawing pen, cursor state (both normal and alternate screens), scroll region, tab stops, charset selection, and response buffering.

Call flushResponses() after each process() pass to deliver any queued device responses through the "writeToHost" event handler in the events map.

simplesect.title: Events
simplesect.para: Video fires events through the events map reference received at construction. Processor owns the map; Session registers handlers on it. Events are fired on the READER THREAD; handlers dispatched via callAsync land on the message thread.
All methods are READER THREAD only unless otherwise stated.
Parser — DFA decoder that drives action methods on this class
CSI — CSI parameter accumulator passed to dispatch handlers
Buffer — cell buffer target for print and erase operations
